names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru’s name page 9596, «Иоанн (Блюмович), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The day’s own line declines the forename and prints no surname at all, «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1938)».

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru closes his line with: «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1938)». It is the only year either page gives.

feast.note: His name page lists one other day, «26 января (Новомуч.)», the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of the Russian Church. One row per church is the schema, so that day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 марта ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Иоанна пресвитера (1938).»

attestations.note: The calendar’s line is all there is: no life page on the day page and none on name page 9596, and no place, no diocese, no arrest and no manner of death. The line and the name page AGREE about his rank, which is worth saying because the 28 марта reader found one who was called a confessor by his line and a hieromartyr by his name page: here both say «сщмч.» and both put him in the clergy, the line as «пресвитера» and the page as «иерей». «26 января (Новомуч.)» on his name page is what `new-martyr` stands on. azbyka.ru was not read.
